topic: Joint-polytope randomized minimax-regret treatment rules under categorical-IV partial identification. For finite positive-probability covariate strata, finite randomized Z, categorical A, and binary Y under exclusion and response-type exogeneity, construct each full response-function action-mean polytope; derive observable dual inequalities iff a pure rule is minimax, enumerate the entire optimal-mixture correspondence, and specialize to Stoye's spike-state result when all spikes are feasible. Build a Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson simultaneous multinomial fiber, cover the population optimizer correspondence, and certify deployed worst-case regret with unique-face root-n theory and uniform set-valued validity across face intersections. Include the exact three-action witness with mu0<=mu2, joint rule q=(0,1/4,3/4), value 3/16, and rectangle rule q=(0,0,1), value 1/4, and target Hruza et al.'s released multicategory implementation. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Exact response-type enumeration for the supplied three-action categorical-IV law attained all ten projected vertices and confirmed the nonrectangular constraint mu0<=mu2. The induced joint-polytope minimax rule q=(0,1/4,3/4) has regret 3/16, while actionwise rectangularization gives q=(0,0,1) and regret 1/4. Writing the response fiber as W(p)={w>=0:Bw=p} reduces the general problem to a finite primal-dual basis enumeration. On the simultaneous Clopper-Pearson event, unioning optimizer correspondences over the confidence fiber contains the true population correspondence, and robust optimization over that fiber upper-bounds deployed regret. Checks covered zero-probability observed cells, every claimed vertex, face ties, rare-cell vacuity, and the Stoye/Hruza/general robust-decision collisions; only the LP machinery was generic. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove Hadamard differentiability of the parametric LP optimizer and value maps on an explicit nondegenerate unique-face margin class, yielding the claimed root-n normal policy and regret law while retaining set-valued uniform validity at face intersections. EARLY KILL TEST: Exhaustively enumerate active bases for the twenty-type witness and its codimension-one face-boundary perturbations, compare every pure-rule certificate and optimizer union with independent exact LP solutions, and stop if any optimizer is omitted or any certificate is false.

open_problems.open_problem: Derive observable necessary-and-sufficient certificates for the complete randomized minimax-regret rule correspondence over the joint categorical-IV action-mean polytope, including pure-rule optimality and exact conditions under which coordinatewise rectangularization preserves the value or optimizer set.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The web literature now occupies sharp joint categorical-IV identification, while the closest categorical treatment-rule paper uses deterministic rules and marginal interval losses. The internal catalogue independently documents globally incompatible endpoint assignments and an unfinished gauge-correct vertex enumerator. The missing step is therefore not another response-type LP: one must replace coordinatewise endpoint substitution by the joint support function h_M(p)(e_b-q), prove the outer simplex minimization and dual certificates, and distinguish equality of values from equality of complete optimizer correspondences. The supplied relation μ0≤μ2 does not by itself verify the numerical witness; its full observable table or full projected polytope is required. Likewise, the claimed Stoye spike-state reduction remains to be derived rather than assumed.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: For every compatible observable law p, give a finite primal-dual characterization of Q*(p)=argmin_{q in Δ} max_b h_M(p)(e_b-q), observable inequalities equivalent to each pure action belonging to Q*(p), exact criteria for joint-versus-rectangle value and optimizer-set equality, an exhaustive extreme-point enumeration, a proved Stoye specialization, and a fully specified realizable three-action law yielding q=(0,1/4,3/4) with value 3/16 versus rectangular q=(0,0,1) with value 1/4.

writing_exemplar.why: Its motivation moves directly from categorical treatment choice under failed point identification to an implementable multicategory rule; the new work can retain that applied arc while changing the decision object from interval-based deterministic choice to joint-polytope randomization.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Point identification of categorical treatment effects is often untenable -> causal bounds still support treatment decisions -> existing multicategory learning uses deterministic interval losses -> characterize and compute the randomized rule supported by the full joint IV polytope.

method_exemplars.technique: Enumerate deterministic response functions, express compatibility and causal targets linearly, and use LP duality to obtain sharp observable inequalities.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired regret support functions are linear projections of exactly the same finite response-law fiber; the new outer minimization changes the loadings but not the causal compatibility representation.

method_exemplars.technique: Convert randomized minimax regret into a finite zero-sum linear program and recover optimal mixtures and adversarial certificates from primal-dual solutions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the mixed-strategy saddle machinery needed after the categorical-IV response fiber has furnished the feasible payoff polytope.

method_exemplars.technique: Use a multicategory surrogate-risk construction and oracle inequality to control learned decision performance, with the released implementation as a reproducibility benchmark.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest categorical-IV policy-learning implementation, although its interval loss must be replaced by the joint-polytope regret oracle and its softmax output is not itself a certified minimax mixture.

open_problems.open_problem: Give explicitly checkable nondegenerate unique-face conditions under which the categorical-IV randomized minimax optimizer and regret value are Hadamard differentiable in the observable cell probabilities, and derive their uniform root-n laws on that margin class.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The closest random-LP limit theorems assume a fixed full-rank constraint matrix and randomness in the right-hand side. In the joint regret formulation, dualization places p in coefficients such as t≥pᵀλ_b, while vertex formulations can have moving payoff rows and changing combinatorial type. Thus their first stability step does not transfer: redundant response constraints must be removed, coefficient perturbations controlled, and a reduced active system shown uniformly invertible. A unique policy is not enough because dual multipliers or bases can remain nonunique, strict complementarity can fail, and face changes destroy full differentiability. The internal joint-policy proposal likewise stopped at plug-in consistency and did not establish constrained-fiber argmax theory.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Define a nonempty class with positive cell-probability margins, fixed reduced response support, uniformly bounded active-system singular values, nonzero primal slacks and reduced-cost gaps; prove a stable active-face representation and its Hadamard derivative under simultaneous coefficient and right-hand-side perturbations; then give separate uniform asymptotic linearity and Gaussian limits for the unique mixture and value, plus counterexamples showing which weaker uniqueness conditions fail.

writing_exemplar.why: Its exposition separates geometric assumptions, degenerate cases, optimizer limits, and value limits, exactly the distinctions the categorical-IV policy theorem must make explicit.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Estimated probability vectors induce random optimization problems -> optimizer geometry determines asymptotics -> degeneracy and selection alter limit laws -> isolate the categorical-IV active-face class on which the policy and regret admit root-n limits.

method_exemplars.technique: Apply parametric optimization sensitivity analysis to a reduced KKT or active-basis system, deriving derivatives only after regularity and stability have been verified.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The requested derivative is a perturbation result for a finite saddle LP; this framework identifies the rank, complementarity, and margin hypotheses needed for a valid implicit linearization.

method_exemplars.technique: Represent optimizer limits through auxiliary linear programs and construct confidence sets for an entire random optimal-solution set.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest computational limit theory for LP optimizer sets, but the categorical-IV proof must extend its fixed-matrix/random-right-hand-side setup to moving coefficients.

method_exemplars.technique: Use the directional functional delta method and derivative-aware resampling, together with the bootstrap-validity criterion distinguishing full from merely directional differentiability.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The regret value and optimizer map become nonsmooth at face changes, so their exact derivative determines both the limit law and whether ordinary bootstrap inference is defensible.

open_problems.open_problem: Construct computable and uniformly honest confidence sets for the entire categorical-IV randomized minimax optimizer correspondence, together with finite-sample certificates for the worst-case regret of the actually deployed mixture, including sequences that approach intersections of optimal faces.

open_problems.why_unsolved: A simultaneous confidence region for observable probabilities immediately yields conservative coverage after projection, so that containment fact alone is not new. The unresolved work begins because the target is the graph of a data-dependent optimization correspondence: taking optimizers after unioning compatible mean sets is generally different from unioning the optimizers for each compatible p. One must compute or certify the latter union, evaluate regret for the actual selected q over the same fiber, obtain informative contraction away from ties, and retain coverage along sequences where active faces intersect. Current categorical-IV inference treats linear functionals, random-LP theory does not cover this coefficient-varying saddle problem uniformly, and the three internal proposals separately leave conservative optimizer coverage, direct finite-sample certificates, and changing-support uniformity unresolved.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: Construct a Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson multinomial confidence fiber with explicit zero-count and compatibility conventions; prove that the computable union of Q*(p) over all compatible p in that fiber covers the full population Q*(p0); give a simultaneous upper certificate for worst-case regret at every deployed q including solver duality error; prove root-n contraction on separated unique-face classes; and prove uniform set coverage, without an invalid Gaussian or Hausdorff-contraction claim, across face-intersection sequences.

writing_exemplar.why: It keeps the set-valued inferential target explicit and cleanly separates coverage from contraction and pointwise limit behavior.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Partial identification makes the target a set -> optimization makes that set a correspondence of minimizers -> plug-in selection is unstable near ties -> construct honest confidence sets for the full randomized optimizer graph and deployed regret.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert exact binomial tests cell by cell and combine their coverage by Bonferroni, including boundary counts, before intersecting with the multinomial simplex and IV compatibility restrictions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The observable categorical-IV law consists of finitely many conditional multinomial cells, so this yields a transparent finite-sample event on which all downstream optimizer and regret certificates can be proved simultaneously.

method_exemplars.technique: Invert a simultaneous observable-law confidence region through sharp categorical-IV linear optimization, with explicit treatment of compatible counterfactual distributions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It already solves simultaneous finite-sample inference over the same categorical-IV identification fiber for linear targets; the new proof must keep the optimizer correspondence and deployed decision inside the inversion.

method_exemplars.technique: Use auxiliary LPs and random convex geometry to form confidence sets for all optimal solutions when the population optimum is nonunique.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired target is likewise an entire optimal set, but the categorical-IV argument must accommodate moving coefficients, causal compatibility fibers, and uniform face intersections.

literature_map:
1. Manski (2000, Journal of Econometrics) separates identification from treatment choice under ambiguity.
2. Manski (2007, Journal of Econometrics) studies binary fractional minimax-regret allocation with missing outcomes.
3. Stoye (2007, Econometric Theory) shows the qualitative many-treatment phenomenon that a pure minimax allocation can occur.
4. Balke and Pearl (1997, JASA) anchor sharp IV bounds; Sachs et al. (2023, JCGS) provide symbolic response-function LP machinery.
5. Jonzon, Sachs, and Gabriel (2023, R Journal) implement accessible response-function bound computation in causaloptim.
6. Song, Guo, Chan, and Richardson (arXiv:2405.09510v6) occupy sharp joint categorical-IV characterization and simultaneous linear-functional inference.
7. Pu and Zhang (2021, JRSSB) provide a binary IV optimal-treatment-rule precursor.
8. Hruza et al. (arXiv:2608.19853) extend partial-identification learning to categorical treatments but use deterministic interval-loss rules; their released code is the implementation benchmark.
9. D'Adamo (arXiv:2111.10904) treats orthogonal policy learning under ambiguity and exposes nonsmooth margin issues.
10. Mastin, Jaillet, and Chin (arXiv:1401.7043) supply randomized minimax-regret game and LP machinery.
11. Bonnans and Shapiro (2000) give the general perturbation framework; Hirano and Porter (2012, Econometrica) delimit regular estimation at nondifferentiable targets.
12. Fang and Santos (2019, Review of Economic Studies) supply the directional delta method and diagnose ordinary-bootstrap failure.
13. Klatt, Munk, and Zemel (2022, Annals of Operations Research) derive random-LP optimizer laws sensitive to degeneracy and selection.
14. Liu, Bunea, and Niles-Weed (COLT 2023; arXiv:2302.12364) cover entire random-LP optimal sets under fixed-matrix/random-right-hand-side assumptions.
15. Chernozhukov, Hong, and Tamer (2007, Econometrica) and Clopper-Pearson (1934, Biometrika) anchor set inference and exact finite-sample cellwise coverage. The exact three-action witness and claimed Stoye spike-state reduction were not verifiable from the topic text alone.

1. The current active qid had state and pipeline records but no proto-core or rejected angle available at scan time.
2. pid_multivalued_iv_vertex_calculus/v1 supplies gauge correction, response-type duals, recognition, and enumeration obstructions; complete polynomial-delay enumeration remains open.
3. pid_ordinal_late_partial_defiers/v1 supplies a global-versus-pairwise rational witness; its observable exact-pasting criterion and inference were not delivered.

5. stat_nonsmooth_asymmetric_mmr_saddle/v2 and its rejected angle supply saddle correspondences and primal-dual certificates while leaving primitive transfer conditions unresolved.
6. Active pid_imperfectref_cutoff_regret/v1 is the closest coherent-regret and optimizer-coverage construction, but its formal scope excludes randomized policies.
